identity: Blue-red spell-copy tempo. This is the GENERAL copy build rather than the creature-targeting one: the payoffs are creatures that read 'whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell', and the kill is Balmor, Battlemage Captain turning each cast into +1/+0 and TRAMPLE for the whole team, so eleven cheap spells convert directly into damage that chump blockers cannot absorb. Lightning Strike x2 is the only reach -- 6 of the 20 damage needed -- because Fires of Victory reads 'target creature or planeswalker' and cannot be pointed at a player; everything else comes through combat. The critical rules fact the build is honest about: a copy made by Twinferno is NOT cast, so it never re-triggers Balmor, Electrostatic Infantry or Ghitu Amplifier -- it multiplies one spell's effect, not the deck's trigger count. The same test cuts the other way and the build follows it there too: Keldon Flamesage and Founding the Third Path both CAST their free spells, so both add real triggers, which is why they replaced Najal, the Storm Runner and the second Twinferno.

restrictions.deck_construction_constraint: max 5 rare/mythic total across mainboard + sideboard

mainboard.name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain trample until end of turn.
mainboard.role: Payoff — the kill mechanism: every instant or sorcery gives the team +1/+0 and TRAMPLE, so blockers cannot absorb it

mainboard.name: Electrostatic Infantry
mainboard.oracle_text:
Trample
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
mainboard.role: Payoff — trample body that gains a PERMANENT +1/+1 counter on each instant or sorcery

mainboard.name: Ghitu Amplifier
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {2}{U} (You may pay an additional {2}{U} as you cast this spell.)
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
mainboard.role: Payoff — +2/+0 per instant or sorcery; kicked {2}{U} bounces an opposing creature on entry

mainboard.name: Haunting Figment
mainboard.oracle_text:
Vigilance
This creature can't be blocked as long as you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
mainboard.role: Threat — unblockable on any turn an instant or sorcery was cast, which is most turns here

mainboard.name: Haughty Djinn
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Haughty Djinn's power is equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
mainboard.role: Engine — 'Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less'; a 4-toughness flier whose power grows with the graveyard

mainboard.name: Keldon Flamesage
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enlist
Whenever this creature attacks, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is this creature's power. You may exile an instant or sorcery card with mana value X or less from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
mainboard.role: Payoff — on attack it exiles an instant or sorcery of mana value <= its power and lets you CAST it for free; a real cast, so it fires every payoff in the deck

mainboard.name: Shivan Devastator
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying, haste
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
mainboard.role: Threat — {X}{R} flying haste with X counters; the mana sink that closes regardless of spell count

mainboard.name: Phoenix Chick
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying, haste
This creature can't block.
Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, you may pay {R}{R}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with a +1/+1 counter on it.
mainboard.role: Threat — 1/1 flying haste that returns from the graveyard when you attack with three or more creatures

mainboard.name: Lightning Strike
mainboard.oracle_text: Lightning Strike deals 3 damage to any target.
mainboard.role: Interaction — 3 damage to ANY target: removal that is also reach, and a payoff trigger

mainboard.name: Fires of Victory
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {2}{U} (You may pay an additional {2}{U} as you cast this spell.)
If this spell was kicked, draw a card. Fires of Victory deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of cards in your hand.
mainboard.role: Interaction — damage equal to cards in hand; kicked {2}{U} it also draws

mainboard.name: Flowstone Infusion
mainboard.oracle_text: Target creature gets +2/-2 until end of turn.
mainboard.role: Interaction — {R} for +2/-2: the cheapest possible payoff trigger, and it kills an X/2 blocker

mainboard.name: Timely Interference
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{R} (You may pay an additional {1}{R} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gets -1/-0 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature blocks this turn if able.
Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Interaction — {U} to shrink a blocker and DRAW a card; a payoff trigger that replaces itself

mainboard.name: Twinferno
mainboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• When you cast your next instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
• Target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn. (It deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.)
mainboard.role: Payoff — mode 2 grants a Balmor-pumped trampler double strike, which is the burst turn; mode 1's copy is NOT cast and adds no trigger

mainboard.name: Founding the Third Path
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 1 or 2 from your hand without paying its mana cost.
II — Target player mills four cards.
III — Exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy.
mainboard.role: Engine — chapter I CASTS a mana-value 1 or 2 instant free (all 11 of this deck's spells qualify) and chapter III CASTS a copy from the graveyard; unlike Twinferno and Najal, both of those are real casts and therefore real payoff triggers

mainboard.name: Impulse
mainboard.oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
mainboard.role: Infrastructure — look at four, take one; a payoff trigger that finds the missing piece

mainboard.name: Thrill of Possibility
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards.
mainboard.role: Infrastructure — discard one draw two; fills the graveyard for Haughty Djinn while digging

mainboard.name: Island
mainboard.role: Land — U source; blue is the lighter colour by pip count but carries both of the deck's double pips

mainboard.name: Mountain
mainboard.role: Land — R source; red is 17 of the 27 coloured pips, every one of them a single pip

mainboard.name: Molten Tributary
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {U} or {R}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — Island Mountain: the UR dual, enters tapped, carries both basic types

mainboard.name: Shivan Reef
mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add {U} or {R}. This land deals 1 damage to you.
mainboard.role: Land — the pool's only UNTAPPED UR dual (rare); {T}: Add {U} or {R}, 1 damage

mainboard.name: Crystal Grotto
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this land enters, scry 1.
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color.
mainboard.role: Land — untapped, scry 1 on entry, and '{1},{T}: Add one mana of any color'; the second copy was added to serve Haughty Djinn's {1}{U}{U} on turn 3

sideboard.name: Essence Scatter
sideboard.role: vs single large threats — counter target creature spell, and still a payoff trigger

sideboard.name: Negate
sideboard.role: vs the cube's 6 sweepers and vs targeted removal aimed at Balmor

sideboard.name: Smash to Dust
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target artifact.
• Destroy target creature with defender.
• Smash to Dust deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
sideboard.role: vs artifacts (15 in the cube) and vs go-wide — 'Destroy target artifact' or '1 damage to each creature your opponents control'

sideboard.name: Jaya's Firenado
sideboard.oracle_text: Jaya's Firenado deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
sideboard.role: vs large single threats — 5 damage to a creature or planeswalker, which the maindeck burn cannot kill

sideboard.name: Impulse
sideboard.oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

sideboard.name: Jaya, Fiery Negotiator
sideboard.oracle_text:
+1: Create a 1/1 red Monk creature token with prowess.
−1: Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
−2: Choose target creature an opponent controls. Whenever you attack this turn, Jaya deals damage equal to the number of attacking creatures to that creature.
−8: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy it twice. You may choose new targets for the copies."
sideboard.role: vs decks that go long — a four-mana engine that makes prowess tokens and refills, for the games where the clock stalls

sideboard.name: Volshe Tideturner
sideboard.oracle_text: {T}: Add {U}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell or a kicked spell.
sideboard.role: vs decks that punish tapping out — '{T}: Add {U}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell or a kicked spell', and a 1/3 blocker

Esta es la construcción de copia GENERAL y no la que apunta a criaturas: las recompensas son criaturas que dicen 'whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell', y la victoria es Balmor, Battlemage Captain convirtiendo cada lanzamiento en +1/+0 y ARROLLAR para todo el equipo, así que once hechizos baratos se convierten directamente en daño que los bloqueadores de carnaza no pueden absorber. Lightning Strike x2 es el único alcance — 6 de los 20 de daño necesarios — porque Fires of Victory dice 'target creature or planeswalker' y no puede apuntarse a un jugador; todo lo demás llega por combate. El hecho de reglas crítico con el que la construcción es honesta: una copia hecha por Twinferno NO se lanza, así que nunca vuelve a disparar a Balmor, Electrostatic Infantry ni Ghitu Amplifier; multiplica el efecto de un hechizo, no el recuento de disparos del mazo. La misma prueba corta en el otro sentido y la construcción también lo sigue ahí: Keldon Flamesage y Founding the Third Path LANZAN ambos sus hechizos gratuitos, así que ambos suman disparos reales, que es por lo que sustituyeron a Najal, the Storm Runner y al segundo Twinferno.
